name: Tsugumi
source:
A prostitute who made a living as Tetsuro's ace in leading his business. They lived together, until she was suddenly abandoned when Asuka appeared and took over her position...

[Translated from [url=https://enoshima210.work/2022/07/08/kagotori/]Official Site[/url]]
